node.text: Lock screen, notification, Bluetooth and Android Auto controls go through the Media3 session. Applies the next time playback starts after the player was closed.
Tools of the MVP0 experiments that need this device. Each one writes a report to copy or share.
This build has no native lab library (USB, Dolby Vision and whisper tools). Use the APK from CI.
Outputs, sample rates, encodings and bit-perfect mixers. Connect the USB DAC first.
Sets the USB DAC's bit-perfect mixer for media, reads it back and clears it again.
Reads the DAC's USB Audio Class descriptors directly: formats, clock and sample rates.
Plays a 1 kHz tone straight to the DAC with libusb, around the Android mixer. Android's own USB output pauses meanwhile.
Choose a remux, then where to save the result: the base layer is copied as is, the enhancement layer dropped, the RPU converted.
Modes, refresh rates, HDR types and EDID of every display. Connect the TV first.
SP-04 · Try 23.976 Hz on the TV
Shows a black screen on the external display, asks for the 24p mode and reports what the TV did.
